name: unnamed-places
description: a desktop software allowing you reach anywhere on the earth in a cute 3d space and checkout the photos you took there.
author: singhi

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n client,serve,electron -c cyan,green,magenta "npm run dev:client" "npm run dev:serve" "npm run dev:electron"
scripts.dev:web: concurrently -k -n client,serve -c cyan,green "npm run dev:client" "npm run dev:serve"
scripts.build: npm run build:client && npm run build:serve
scripts.pack: npm run build:serve:deps && npm run build && electron-builder --dir
scripts.pack:mac: npm run build:serve:deps && npm run build && electron-builder --mac
scripts.pack:mac:zip: npm run build:serve:deps && npm run build && electron-builder --mac zip
